map.桥梁挠度计算器，求简支梁在均布或集中荷载下的挠度并校核允许挠度，输入弹性模量、惯: The bridge deflection calculator computes the deflection of a simply supported beam under uniform or concentrated load and checks it against the allowable deflection, taking elastic modulus, second moment of area and span to guarantee stiffness.
map.楼盖与桥梁挠度限值与刚度验算：混凝土结构设计时，按荷载、跨度与截面刚度估算受弯构: Deflection limit and stiffness checks for floor slabs and bridges: in concrete structure design, estimate the deflection of flexural members from load, span and section stiffness and check against the GB 50010 / JTG 3362 limits (e.g. L/250, L/400).
map.既有结构开裂与下挠诊断：检测单位用实测跨度和荷载反算挠度，对比规范限值判断是否需: Cracking and deflection diagnosis of existing structures — the testing unit back-calculates deflection from measured span and load and compares it with code limits to decide whether strengthening (steel plate bonding, carbon fibre or a larger section) is needed.
map.预制构件起拱设计：生产单位根据挠度估算值预设反拱，避免吊装后外观下垂，尤其对大跨: Precast member camber design — the producer presets camber from the deflection estimate to avoid visible sag after lifting, especially for long-span prestressed beams and slabs.
map.：均布荷载 q=20 kN/m、跨度 L=6 m、抗弯刚度 EI=2.0e8 k: : uniformly distributed load q=20 kN/m, span L=6 m, flexural rigidity EI=2.0e8 kN·m²: mid-span deflection of the simply supported beam 5qL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 10.1 mm, about L/594, below the common limit L/400 (15 mm), so stiffness is satisfied. Reducing EI shows deflection rising.
map.混凝土梁板按 GB 50010 通常取 L/200~L/400（依使用功能），桥: Concrete beams and slabs usually take L/200~L/400 under GB 50010 (depending on function), and bridges L/400~L/600 under JTG 3362; dynamic members such as crane girders are stricter. The design documents govern.
map.混凝土徐变与收缩会使挠度随时间增长，长期挠度可达短期值的 1.5~2 倍，预应力: Concrete creep and shrinkage make deflection grow over time, and long-term deflection can reach 1.5~2 times the short-term value; prestressed members also require deducting camber, so design should superimpose these.
map.结果能直接出具检测报告吗？: Can the results be issued directly as a test report?
map.本工具为理论估算，正式检测须现场实测挠度、核对荷载史并附仪器检定证书，结果仅供初: This tool is a theoretical estimate; formal testing must measure deflection on site, verify the load history and attach instrument calibration certificates — results serve only for preliminary judgement and scheme comparison.
